name: preempt-rt-sd-dma-full-fifo

change.description: Replace the board-specific polled MMCI PIO path with STM32 DMA2 streams 3/6 channel 4, matching the DMA resources used by the oveRTOS SD implementation. Retain one-sector transfers and use the STM32 DMA full-FIFO mode.

constant_contract.kernel: Linux 5.15.211-rt97 ARM NOMMU FDPIC XIP from QSPI
constant_contract.data: VFAT on the same SD card at approximately 1.95 MHz
constant_contract.latency: TIM3 CH1 PB4/D3 hardware reference to priority-99 SCHED_FIFO kthread PG7/D4 response

boot.observation: The first partition-table receive left data in the MMCI FIFO. MMCI reported a DMA transfer error, classified the DMA as buggy, released both channels, and emitted two PREEMPT_RT tasklet-from-interrupt warnings. Rootfs subsequently booted, but /data initialization did not reach a login prompt after fallback to the known-broken PIO path.

storage_probe.reason: DMA was disabled during partition discovery and /data initialization did not complete.

hammer.reason: The SD transport was not safe enough to mount or repair the benchmark FAT volume.

decision: Keep the DMA stream/channel assignment, but test the STM32 DMA direct-mode feature so each MMCI request uses single beats without the DMA FIFO. This is an isolated DTB-only change and avoids another kernel or rootfs QSPI write.
interpretation: Moving SD servicing out of threaded PIO is the correct RT architecture, but the full-FIFO DMA configuration does not drain the STM32F746 MMCI receive FIFO correctly. This iteration cannot be benchmarked.
